source.derivation: codexFraming(body) and harnessInventoryShape(codexDeclarations(body), <every declared name>) from test/helpers/harness-golden.ts. Passing the vendor's own names as `boundNames` makes `boundNaming` the harness's naming convention — the half omp's renamed tools must match — and leaves `unboundNaming` empty. Only the projections are vendored: the ~21k-char harness prompt and the vendor tool descriptions take part in no assertion here.
source.regenerate: point OMP_HARNESS_CAPTURE_DIR at the capture directory and run the local-only block in harness-golden-contract.test.ts; it re-projects the captures and asserts they still match vendorFraming/vendorInventory.

documentedFramingDeltas.envelope.reasoning: omp keeps `reasoning.summary` (visible thinking); `reasoning.context` now matches the vendor (`all_turns`).

documentedInventoryDeltas.unboundNaming: by design: omp keeps `grep`, `glob`, `todo`, `learn`, `recall` and the state-machine tools that the harness has no counterpart for, so their names stay in omp's own convention. The vendor projection passes every captured name as bound, so its unbound set is empty. Membership is the free half of the two-tier contract.
